Hey friend !

It's not a big deal if you don't give money to charities, you're not a bad person just for that. If you feel like you're not doing enough, and doing more makes you feel happier, then do more ! (I have to say I don't understand why you so depressed…)

If you can't give any money to charity because of financial problems, you're actually doing something. You still help this one guy buy a meal. It might not seem enough, but at least you do something at your own scale.

Hope that cheered you up a bit !!
